findings.issue: אָדָם is a common noun (absolute), left untranslated as adam.
Suffix is 1st common plural; desde él is 3rd masculine singular.
Qal sequential perfect 3ms is a bare participle; culpado can read as passive blamed and drops the finite verb.

notes: או כי, the qal touch/become-unclean chain, niphal concealment, and explicit הוא track; subjunctive mood is smoothing.
